purpose: targets the student draws on the touch canvas; compared against the ADAB conformer's decoded string

model.input: raw touch strokes: list[stroke], stroke = list[[x, y]] in draw order
model.preprocessing: parse_inkml equivalent -> preprocess_strokes(fcut=10.0, fs=125.0, target_height=100.0) -> allograph segmentation -> feature vectors -> normalize with feat_norm_adab.pt
notes: 'لا' (index 36) is unreachable: text_to_labels iterates per character, so it was never emitted as a training label.
No tashkeel classes — targets must be diacritic-free.
Trained on ADAB (Tunisian place names, 1-3 short tokens), so single-word targets match the training shape; the vocabulary domain does not.

normalization: NFC, drop Unicode combining marks, collapse whitespace
